reason: I'll start with the cut, since the story says it creates the break that needs repair.
expectation: I expect the rough edge to break the skin and a small blood vessel, making a site for the platelet plug.

alternatives.reason: The label explains that enzymes help make reinforcing threads, but I want to make the break first.

effect: The cut reaches a leaking blood vessel, so there's now a place for the platelets to gather.
reaction: The picture makes the leak and the next step clear.
reason: I'll gather platelets at the cut to start plugging the leak.
expectation: I expect the platelets to stick together at the damaged vessel and form a plug.

alternatives.reason: I could make reinforcing threads first, but the plug gives them something to reinforce.

effect: The platelet plug slows the leak, but the surface cut remains open; the reinforcing threads are still needed.
reaction: It makes sense that the plug slows bleeding without closing the whole cut.
reason: I'll follow the only available combination to make the reinforcing threads described in the goal.
expectation: I expect the enzymes to help the dissolved clotting protein form threads that can reinforce the plug.

effect: The clotting proteins formed a mesh, which can now reinforce the platelet plug.
reaction: The branching mesh makes the threads' reinforcing role easier to picture.
reason: I'll use the only available combination to reinforce the plug and stop the bleeding.
expectation: I expect the protein threads to strengthen the platelet plug and stop the leak, though the skin surface may still need repair.

effect: The mesh reinforced the plug and stopped the bleeding, but the skin surface still needs to heal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the leak stop without pretending the whole cut was healed.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reinforcing the platelet plug was most worthwhile because it brought the two parts together and showed how the bleeding stops.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the protein threads was the least engaging step: it was the only available combination, and the enzyme's role was already given in the label.

surprise.text: The platelet plug slowed the leak while leaving the surface cut open; even the reinforced clot did not heal the skin.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary. The cut, plug and reinforcing mesh each had a clear purpose, though the enzyme pairing was supplied rather than figured out.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the open skin heals after the bleeding stops. The distinction made me curious about the next stage.
